attribution: Athletic.net public published results and team directory; retained as parser contract evidence. No redistribution license or additional permission is asserted. No private session/account data retained.

result_retention.individual_rows: Raw published marks, including DNS/DNF/DQ, remain individual results when source athlete identity is public.
result_retention.team_and_unidentified_rows: One UnassignedResult per published relay-team or unidentified result. A relay team mark is never duplicated into individual leg performances or PRs.
result_retention.members: Published athlete IDs are encoded athleticnet:<id>; a reported name is used only if an ID is absent. UnassignedResult.raw preserves the original row and available relayLegs.
